finding.failure_mode: The nine-kind fixture derives expected records from the same fixture helper used to build RuntimeScene input and leaves derived RuntimeScene fields at defaults.
finding.impact: The frozen structural oracle cannot independently detect loss or corruption of geometryBounds, visualBounds, worldBounds, referenceGeometryDigest, or directDependencies, and therefore cannot prove complete record-value preservation.
finding.existing_independent_coverage: G3-03-V2 identity/order/clip checks, V3 digest mutation checks, V4 locality counters, V5 boundary scan, and 19 RF01/G2 regressions pass, but none independently proves the missing full-field corpus.
finding.unique_detection_value: A hand-authored non-empty full-field expected corpus catches field omission or incorrect mapping that the current self-derived/default-empty fixture cannot detect.
finding.why_frozen_evidence_missed_it: The initial implementation focused on typed command, identity, digest, and locality behavior; the fixture inventory claimed complete fields without independently populating or comparing all derived fields.

preserved_valid_work: G3 predecessor and RF01/G2 regression coverage
